tools.description: Venture funds (fintech, partly fintech or generalist) with their manager, status, stages, latest close and size or target. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: q (or query) matched against fund and manager name; fintech_focus; stage; country (ISO-style country slug, e.g. 'italy'); status; closed_after (YYYY-MM-DD: a close on or after this date); limit. Newest close first. Unknown arguments are rejected.

closed_after.description: Only funds with a close on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

q.description: Text matched against fund and manager names.

tools.name: search_funds
tools.title: Search venture funds

tools.description: Approved venture-fund closes, newest first: fund, manager, close_type (launch, target, first, interim, final, unspecified), date, amount and currency as announced, source. Amounts are as announced, in their own currency, never converted. size is from the latest first/interim/final close with an amount; a target is never reported as size. Funds focused on other sectors are not included. Arguments: since / until (YYYY-MM-DD), close_type, fintech_focus, limit. Without close_type only first, interim and final closes are listed. Unknown arguments are rejected.
tools.name: list_fund_closes

tools.description: Funds that raised in the last 24 months and are backing fintech rounds in the last 12: approved funds (not other-sector) whose latest first/interim/final close is within 24 months and whose manager invested in public equity rounds in the last 12 months (at least 1 for fintech funds, 2 for generalist or unknown focus). Per fund: manager, latest close, size or target as announced (never converted), rounds_12m, rounds_since_close and the 3 latest rounds. Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). limit ≤ 50. Unknown arguments are rejected.
tools.name: list_deploying_funds
tools.title: List funds deploying now

tools.description: How many investors backed public fintech equity rounds in the last 12 months that match a country / stage / sub-sector, the top 3 investors by matching rounds (with whether they have a fund on Deploying now), and a coverage caveat (share of rounds in the period with a known country). Optional filters apply to the qualifying rounds: topic (topic slug, via the news linked to the round), country (company's country slug), stage (pre-seed, seed, series-a, series-b, series-c-plus, growth — derived from round_type). All arguments optional. Unknown arguments are rejected.
tools.name: coverage_check
tools.title: Coverage check: investors behind matching fintech rounds

tools.description: Fintech reports, white papers, surveys and data, newest first, with publisher, type, date and gated flag. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Arguments: q (or query, ≥2 characters) matched against title and summary; topic (topic slug); publisher (organisation or person slug); report_type; year; gated (true/false); limit (≤50); cursor (next_cursor from a previous call). Use get_report for figures and coverage. Unknown arguments are rejected.

gated.description: true = registration required at the publisher; false = free to read.

q.description: Text matched against report title and summary (at least 2 characters).

report_type.description: survey, market_data, index, white_paper, regulatory_analysis or industry_research.

tools.name: search_reports
tools.title: Search fintech reports

tools.description: One report by slug: publisher and co-publishers, date, type, gated flag, summary, up to 5 key figures (value and unit exactly as written, each with page_ref), methodology note, source_url (the publisher's own page for the report) and the news / newsletters that covered it. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Unknown arguments are rejected.

Amounts are never converted. Arguments: topic (required, topic slug), week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W45'; omit for the current week). Always returns available_weeks (last 12 weeks with at least one story). Unknown topic → error listing the digest topics. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W45'). Omit for the current week.

tools.description: The weekly Builders Fintech Funding Index of approved equity rounds (ISO weeks). Arguments: week (optional, 'YYYY-Www', e.g. '2026-W39') returns that week; otherwise the latest weeks, newest first. weeks (optional, 1–104, default 1) sets how many. Count Index = rounds this week / average of the prior 12 weeks × 100. USD median index uses disclosed USD rounds only (needs 5). Amounts are never converted. Published values are frozen; revised_* shows later corrections. coverage_affected is true when a coverage change falls in the week or its 12-week baseline; coverage_note then explains how the index overstates activity. Unknown arguments are rejected.

week.description: ISO week, 'YYYY-Www' (e.g. '2026-W39'). Omit for the latest.

tools.description: The monthly Fintech Signals report: stored figures for approved equity rounds in one month (headline rounds and per-currency totals/medians, comparison with previous months, largest rounds per currency, stages, countries with 3+ rounds, topics with 5+ rounds, investors with 2+ rounds, and debt/fund/IPO items not counted). Amounts are never converted; totals and rankings are per currency. Arguments: month (optional, 'YYYY-MM'); omit for the latest published edition. Always returns available_months. Each report carries date_published and date_modified (revised_at, else the item's last content update, else published). Unknown arguments are rejected.

tools.description: Find companies by product category, licence (licensed_in matches the home country or any passported country), licence type, authority, and agent access (has_sandbox, has_mcp, has_api), optionally min_agent_ready (1–5, the product's Agent-Ready score; available once those results are published). Returns each company with its approved products (with agent_access), LEI, licence summaries and self-reported certifications. Every licence carries source_url and last_checked_at so you can verify it on the regulator's register. From public registers as of the last-checked date. Always confirm on the regulator's register before relying on it. Use list_provider_filters for valid slugs. Ordered by company name, then slug. cursor is the next_cursor from a previous page. Unknown arguments are rejected.

licensed_in.description: Two-letter ISO country code; matches home or passported licences.

min_agent_ready.description: Only companies with a product whose Agent-Ready score is at least this (1–5). Available once Agent-Ready results are published.
